Implemented the 10-move motion vocabulary from the 2026-10-02 Gemini handoff (151 unit assertions, mutation-checked against 6 seeded faults). Worked reliably on a long multi-file change, but two operational lessons: (1) the editor insert_line tool silently truncated/scrambled files twice, producing parse errors far from the edit - always re-read and brace-balance-check after an insert_line; (2) subagents and long-running gates fail under the 30s shell timeout, so run gates in detached Start-Process and poll the output file.

Second session: implemented the Canvas2D per-mode effect budget from the 2026-10-02 diagnosis doc (54 assertions, 5 seeded mutations all caught). Verified every claim in the handoff against the source before changing anything - it was accurate to the line. Two editor insert_line failures again (a stray import block, a comment block that lost its // prefixes); both surfaced as parse errors far from the edit, and both were caught by eslint/tsc rather than by reading. Practical lesson: after any multi-part structural edit to a large file, re-read the touched region AND run tsc before moving on.

Follow-up: browser automation found a real dead-UI bug that reading the code had missed - aurora was implemented, budgeted and unit-tested but absent from the hardcoded picker, reachable only via the test harness. Root cause was four divergent copies of the mode list; collapsed to one. Also found an option with value stereo-split-bands that is not a mode. Lessons: (1) hardcoded <option> lists drift from typed source-of-truth arrays - render from the array; (2) when writing a Playwright guard that parses served source, do not anchor the regex on TS-only syntax - Vite strips `as const`, so the match returns empty and the test passes vacuously; I hit exactly this and caught it only by mutation-testing the guard; (3) mutation-testing your own new test is the only way to know it can fail.

Test-suite audit: full Playwright run found 3 failures, all from ONE environmental cause - the Vite devtools overlay intercepting pointer events and fetching icons from an external CDN (whose CORS errors then failed console assertions). Completed plan Phase 1 item 1.4 (Cosmic Dust frame wash). Root cause was two shader bugs in instancedParticles.tsx, isolated by an atomic in-page 2x2 causal probe (rotation x scale, write+render+readPixels in one JS task to beat the per-frame lerp): (1) billboard offsets built from world-space camera axes then multiplied through modelViewMatrix, so the LrcViz wrapper's continuous rotation.y sheared the quads - brightness was purely f(ry mod 2pi): face-on wash 0.71+ at ry~0, invisible slivers 0.03 at ry~pi, which is why wash bands kept appearing at different musical positions in different runs (falsified: position-determinism, bass correlation, distance-clump, DOM overlay); (2) baseSize prop never destructured - all styles rendered hardcoded 0.4-1.4 world-unit dust instead of the 0.08-0.1 callers pass (~10x area). Fixed with view-space billboard (mvPosition.xy += offset), honored baseSize (added to deps), added uAlpha uniform. Verified: rotation-invariant means (0.202/0.196/0.200), scene mean 0.20-0.34 video-luma / 0.14-0.19 rel-lum, frac>0.92=0, lyric contrast 10.4-17.3, all 3 particle styles re-captured clean, gates+e2e green. Lessons: (1) a wrong oracle early (scene background hex #000510, only set by preset auto-apply) aborts probes while the style is actually fine - verify via .active button title instead; (2) backend flapped constantly from a concurrent agent restarting it - gate probe runs on two consecutive health+files+audio-file checks 8s apart, and the audio-file URL needs the CURLY apostrophe (U+2019), a straight one 404s forever; (3) atomic multi-variant measurement inside one page.evaluate defeats the useFrame lerp that would otherwise restore state between set and read; (4) fixed tools/vision/analyze.mjs missing baseName import (ReferenceError at resolveModel); vision MCP compare still flaky (timeouts/empty), gemma4 describe worked. Filesystem MCP investigation: root-caused search_files timeouts on this repo - excludePatterns must match the directory itself (**/node_modules prunes the walk; **/node_modules/** still walks the whole tree and only filters results, which is why earlier attempts timed out). Corrected the record: the filesystem MCP is the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem npm package (v2026.8.31) declared in the GLOBAL ~/.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc, not a Kilo built-in and not in the project config. Raised its timeout 15s->60s as margin; exclusions are the real fix. Documented the full exclusion recipe in AGENTS.md + machine memory. Verified: full **/*.ts search returns thousands of hits in seconds with exclusions. Lesson: read the server's dist/lib.js (searchFilesWithValidation) before theorizing about pattern semantics - the exclusion check runs before recursion.

MISTAKE WORTH RECORDING: I then formed a second hypothesis from the same shallow read -- that six async def handlers (hyperframes.py, integrations_misc.py, integrations_config.py) block the event loop with bare subprocess.run -- wrote a 12-test file asserting it, and only measured before committing. Measured 813214/458066/262949/291685/365323 concurrent event-loop turns for those handlers: the offloading via services.subprocess_runner.run_subprocess_thread was ALREADY correct (import visible at hyperframes.py:15). Ollama health-flap root cause + fix. Symptom: /api/health/health intermittently reported BOTH adapters offline (~2/10 probes, both together, fast, no error) while top-level status stayed healthy and chat/inference worked (OLLAMA_CHAT_OK verified end-to-end via POST /api/integrations/ollama/chat with gemma4:e2b-it-qat). Root cause: main.py health_broadcast_loop mutated the SHARED cached dict returned by get_aggregate_health() - it set adapter status healthy->online in place; the /api/health endpoint then re-maps status with (online if status==healthy else offline), so the already-mapped online reads as offline. Any probe landing in the 2s cache window after a 5s broadcast therefore reported healthy adapters as offline. Fix: build a copy for broadcasting instead of mutating the cache (main.py health_broadcast_loop). Verified: 12/12 probes online after watchfiles hot-reload (new uvicorn worker PID), type+lint gates PASS, chat still OLLAMA_CHAT_OK. Measurement discipline (per AGENTS.md measure-before-naming-a-defect): denied stale-keepalive (0/16 failures with 10s gaps) and concurrent-aggregate-race (0/30 with forced-stale concurrent checks) hypotheses via clean standalone repros; the exact code path was 0/20 in a fresh process, which localized the defect to the running processs broadcast loop rather than the adapter code. The bug was invisible reading either file alone - the mutation lives in main.py, the mis-mapping in api/health.py; only the live endpoint showed the signature (top-level healthy + adapters offline). Separate finding (not Ollama, unfixed): all 5 Go sidecars (go-dashboard/media/worker/gateway/ports, ports 3847-3851) offline with httpcore ConnectTimeout.

Playwright suite review/fix/improvement (packages/frontend/tests, 17 specs + helpers + config). Baseline measured before edits: 79 passed / 6 failed - all six the same root cause, the dashboard drop-zone aria-label copy changed (Dashboard.tsx: '...to start making a music video, or click to browse your files. You can also paste an audio file directly.') while two specs hardcoded the old sentence. Fixed with a substring-regex locator (helpers.dashboardDropZone). Other fixes, each verified by measurement not reading: (1) getBaseUrl hardcoded :5173 while playwright.config.ts reads config/ports.json - unified onto a ports.json reader with PW_BASE_URL override; (2) removeDevToolOverlays registered a NEW page.route handler per call (navigateWithWait + cleanupRoutes) with no unroute - handler leak, now one per page via WeakSet + unroute in cleanupRoutes; (3) my own first refactor of that handler destructured ({route}) - Playwright passes route positionally, TypeError poisoned every request and 12/12 tests failed - fixed handler(route) and caught it by re-running; (4) dispatchSseEvent gated on __healthStore/__jobStore then never read them - silent no-op when only __sseService existed; now gates on the service and throws if absent; (5) filechooser-based picker assertions are unreliable after ~2 programmatic opens per browser session (measured: click ok, Enter ok, Space times out; 3rd+ chooser suppressed) - pointer path keeps the OS filechooser event, keyboard paths assert openPicker() via a capture-phase input click counter (expectKeyOpensPicker); (6) canvas2d + lrc read the track select's option count once immediately after it became visible - measured 1 option then (placeholder) vs 62 once the async audioLibraryStore lands, so selectOption never fired and lrc-visualizer was doubly vacuous (it also polled a harness field lyrics that never existed and read storyboard.currentSection which is on neither Storyboard {track,duration,beats} nor StoryState - the section-aware block could never run). Rewritten against the real harness surface (currentFilename, lyricsVisible, storyboard.beats) with in-test LRC discovery over the real library (62 entries, exactly one with a parseable .lrc) and an explicit skip when none; (7) vacuous tests made real: gpu/logs 'body visible' -> mocked snapshot values (RTX name, 35%, 61C, 4.0 GB; Errors=1/Info=2 cards), sidebar collapse (aria-label flip + aside collapsed class) and health nav (unconditional URL), dashboard drag (real DataTransfer dragenter/dragover/drop -> border-violet-500 class + role=alert for rejected .txt, with (^|\s) anchoring because the idle class list contains hover:border-violet-500/40 which an unanchored regex matched); (8) unity.spec shared describe-scoped record -> per-test records via setupUnityMocks (parallel-safe), unit tests moved to a page-free describe (1ms, no route setup); (9) removed 8 dead helper exports (zero callers; tests/browser/*.mjs are standalone), unified 30+ duplicated ['502','Bad Gateway','ECONNREFUSED'] arrays onto BACKEND_OFFLINE_FILTERS. Full suite after: 86 passed (2.9m), gates type+lint PASS. Tooling notes: background_process failed to spawn (ENOENT on C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.EXE) - used the shell tool with a raised timeout; PowerShell -replace with a scriptblock evaluator silently did nothing and a mis-quoted import-insertion dropped the './helpers' tail in 12 files - both caught by re-reading files and type-check, so verify mechanical edits by compiling, not by the command's exit status.
